author_entrypoint: notebooks/Tutorial_PerturbNet_Chemicals.ipynb (scVI cells 20-24, covariate cINN cells 40-46, scVI inference cells 71-82)

chemical_vae.train_data: unique representative SMILES of the fold's training drugs (220/276 in the author 80% split)
chemical_vae.standardize: mu/std of the 196-d latent recomputed on all training-fold structures

cell_vae.train_data: training-role treated wells, raw counts (scVI's internal 90/10 split)

cinn.dose_encoding: 3-bin one-hot over the fold's training doses
cinn.checkpoint_selection: author NLL on the cold valid drugs (scVI posterior mean target)

prediction.decode: scVI ZINB rate (px_rate) from the decoder, i.e. the per-draw predictive mean; no count sampling
prediction.library: median training-fold library size (cp10k is library-size invariant for the rate)
prediction.target_space: log1p_cp10k minus the matched plate DMSO mean

notes.ideal_fit: partial: the authors' condition does not take a control transcriptome
notes.dose: 0.2 / 1 / 10 uM -> 3-bin one-hot (ticket 09); the tutorial uses raw continuous dose
notes.chemical_vae: from scratch on the fold's training structures; released ZINC weights are not loaded
notes.cell_vae: scVI is fitted on training counts only; no valid/test expression enters any stage
